name: Post Style Handoff CPU Profile

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: headed Test Suite WASM/WebGPU CPU profile
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Post Style Handoff CPU Profile Hypothesis

A fresh CPU profile after the accepted frame-bounded style handoff and Taffy-request telemetry will identify the current dominant gpux-owned costs and provide a better-ranked next mechanism than further speculative topology micro-optimization.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

### Scope Lock

Read-only CPU profiling and sampled-stack aggregation only. Production source, dependencies, Test Suite fixtures, diagnostics schemas, performance fixes, and memory/skill claims are forbidden.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Run the canonical wide DataTable headed WebGPU benchmark once at DPR1 and DPR2 with Chromium CPU profiling enabled. Require exact runtime assertions, final offset, and zero errors. Aggregate sampled self time by function, compare the largest gpux/Taffy/allocator families with experiment 72, and produce a ranked list of single-mechanism candidates. Raw profiles remain under ignored `artifacts-temp`.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

The profile should either identify at least one current high-confidence gpux-owned mechanism for iteration 77 or record that the remaining sampled costs require narrower telemetry before production changes.

reportMarkdown:
## Post Style Handoff CPU Profile Finished

**Passed Status:** true. The measurement-only headed WebGPU run passed at both DPRs with exact runtime invariants and no production changes.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

The dominant sampled family remains upstream Taffy layout: flexbox plus block self time totals 872.269 ms at DPR1 and 907.045 ms at DPR2. The gpux-owned request path remains actionable: `request_taffy_node` samples 278.765/277.843 ms and `Style::to_taffy` another 102.412/107.110 ms, while diagnostics prove every warmed style and ordered topology is unchanged. However, iteration 75 rejects another topology comparison micro-optimization; sound invalidation or phase reuse is required.

Allocator self time totals 485.962/478.928 ms, BoundsTree insertion 176.006/155.439 ms, element-path Arc construction 120.032/149.270 ms, and style refine plus compute 199.988/207.524 ms. The request-to-prepaint boundary is the narrowest next measurement opportunity because the same Interactivity currently computes request style and then 845 prepaint styles, while the accepted prepaint-to-paint store already proves 729 structurally static elements can cross the later boundary.

Ranked next candidates: (1) measure conservative request-to-prepaint style eligibility and consumption; (2) design a caller-visible style/layout generation before bypassing `to_taffy`; (3) narrow allocator attribution; (4) revisit BoundsTree only with a new traversal mechanism; (5) avoid another GlobalElementId interner because the earlier retained interner regressed.

### Scope Lock

No production source, dependency, fixture, diagnostic schema, memory, or skill file changed.
decisionMarkdown:
### Decision

Keep the current production checkpoint. Start iteration 77 as diagnostics-only request-to-prepaint style eligibility telemetry. Do not optimize topology again, and do not bypass Taffy style conversion without a sound caller-visible invalidation contract.
